description: Tool definitions that let a coding or operations agent call the authorization service. Each tool maps to an operation in openapi.yaml.

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Check whether a user may perform an action. Read only.

tools.name: revoke_role
tools.description: Revoke a role from a user. Changes access within 60 seconds and is audited. Requires the access-admin role and a human confirmation.

user_id.description: The user who loses the role

reason.description: Why the role is revoked; stored in the audit log
